title: DONKII: Characterizing and Detecting Errors in Instruction-Tuning Datasets
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as its focus is on detecting technical and factual errors in instruction-tuning datasets.

measurement_description: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. The benchmark, DONKII, is designed to characterize and detect annotation errors in instruction-tuning datasets for Large Language Models, focusing on issues like incorrect outputs, factual errors, and formatting problems.
